fields.body: Year 1 walks the Class 11 units, year 2 the Class 12 units, and the closing weeks are held for revision and full mocks. Week records carry the plan's shape; add start and end dates to them when you want the plan pinned to real days.
fields.title: How this plan is laid out

fields.body: One weekly test on a rolling subject rotation, a part test after each cluster of chapters, and a full mock once the whole syllabus has been seen once.
fields.title: Test rhythm

fields.body: Every wrong answer goes into the problemset record for its chapter: total, attempted, solved. The percentage is computed from solved and total, never typed, so the table cannot drift from the counts.
fields.title: Error log
